written: 2026-10-24, before any of the runs in results/runs/ and before random_search.py existed
seen_before_writing: first fit and best fit on the three instance sets: evolve 5.340% and 4.781% over L1, held-out 4.854% and 4.382%, shift 5.409% and 5.012%

one batch of 4 replies to the seed prompt (two cut at 512 tokens or returning -inf, which led us to allow infinite scores and ask for short code), and a 12-candidate smoke run of evolve (seed 99), deleted: 11 of 12 children valid, 10 of them behaving exactly like best fit
budget: 400 sampled candidates per run, one evaluator call each except exact repeats; 4 replies per prompt

expectations.E1: evolve: the best program's excess on the evolve set is below best fit's 4.781% in every one of 3 seeds, and the mean of the 3 is at most 4.30%.
expectations.E2: evolve beats noselect (same budget, always the two seed parents) on the evolve set by at least 0.2 points, mean of 3 seeds each.
expectations.E3: evolve beats random search over a small expression grammar (same budget, no LLM) on the evolve set by at least 0.2 points, mean of 3 seeds each.
expectations.E4: Held-out (10 new Weibull instances): each evolve seed's best program keeps at least half of its evolve-set gain over best fit (best fit held-out 4.382%).
expectations.E5: Shift (uniform sizes 20-100, capacity 150): the evolve programs' gain over best fit (5.012%) is smaller than on held-out, or reverses, for at least 2 of 3 seeds.
expectations.E6: noverifier: in at least 2 of 3 seeds the program the loop ends with is worse than best fit on the evolve set or fails to run, and at least 20% of its children fail (screen, crash, timeout, invalid or no function).
expectations.E7: evolve: at least 60% of sampled children are valid programs (status valid).
expectations.E8: evolve: exact code repeats (after dropping comments and docstrings) are under 10% of sampled candidates.
expectations.E9: evolve_flat (cluster choice uniform instead of by score, seed 0 only): its best evolve-set excess is worse than the evolve mean.
